{{nihongo|'''Kuninomi Shrine (Legendary Site B, Tokorocho, Matsusaka)'''|（伝承地B）松阪市土古路町}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ise Province]].
